Thanks again for the call this morning — good discussion and appreciate the clarity on regulatory constraints.  Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:  

Key notes from the call:
- Compliance scope: HealthTech is subject to HIPAA (US) and GDPR (EU). You also flagged internal auditors asking about SOC 2 (you noted Type II in-progress).
- Desired deployment: private/VPC-first, with potential air-gapped option for specific workloads; on-prem presence in NJ + cloud-hosted private VPCs in eu-west and us-east.
- Primary asks from your side: vendor security questionnaire, network/topology diagram, SLA and data retention/backup posture.

Attachments included with this email:
- Redwood-RFI-template.pdf (vendor security questionnaire template)
- private-deploy-playbook.md (high-level options for VPC / on-prem / air-gapped flows)

Proposed immediate actions (owner / due):
1) HealthTech: share current network diagram (minimal sketch OK) and list of regulatory requirements beyond HIPAA/GDPR — owner: Samantha — due: 2027-06-03
2) Redwood: populate initial vendor questionnaire and send DPA/BAA draft — owner: Jordan — due: 2027-06-01
3) Technical deep-dive to validate air-gap feasibility and integration points (KV cache persistence, KMS/HSM, offline model update path) — owner: Rishi — propose week of 6/7
4) Mutual action plan (timeline & deliverables) — owner: Jordan/Marissa — due: 2027-06-04

Open questions we need resolved before the deep-dive:
- Do you require a physically air-gapped appliance (no egress) for any tenant data processing? If so, which workloads?
- Who is your security liaison (name/email) for SOC/GDPR evidence collection?
- Any hard requirements on key management (customer-managed keys, HSMs)?

If that all looks right, I will: (a) send you a populated RFI and our standard DPA/BAA for review, (b) schedule a technical deep-dive with Rishi and infra on your preferred week.

Thanks — Jordan

On Sat, May 29, 2027 at 16:10, Samantha Reeves <samantha@healthtech.com> wrote:
> Thanks Jordan — good summary.  Quick answers inline:  
> 
> - Network diagram: attaching a very rough sketch to get started (initial-network-sketch.png). We'll follow up with an internal topology doc once legal clears it.
> - Compliance/timelines: SOC 2 Type II report is in progress; target date for completion is Nov 2027. We are already HIPAA-covered in the US and have a dedicated privacy team for GDPR in the EU.
> - Air-gap needs: At the moment, there are two workloads under consideration for physical isolation — PHI ingestion pipelines and the downstream model hosting for diagnostic assistance. We need to confirm feasibility during the deep-dive.

Thanks for the context — a few technical areas we'll want to cover in the deep-dive so we can validate architecture and surface gaps:  

1) Key management: do you require customer-managed keys (CMK) and an HSM-backed KMS for encryption at rest? If so, are keys stored centrally (cloud KMS) or on-prem HSMs?  
2) KV cache / state: any requirement that the model runtime persist local KV cache across restarts (this impacts disk encryption and snapshot strategy) or is ephemeral acceptable?
3) Network isolation: are you looking for full physical air-gap (no egress allowed) or logically air-gapped VPCs with controlled transfer nodes? If physically air-gapped, what's the defined data egress process (sneakernet / removable media / controlled bridge)?
4) Images & updates: for air-gapped hosts, do you have a defined process for importing signed model/container images? Can we use SHA-signed artifacts and a secure transit procedure?
5) Auditing & evidence: what format do your auditors prefer for SOC evidence (CSV exports, PDF screenshots, console logs)? We can provide runbooks for evidence extraction but need to match their requirements.

If you can confirm the above, we'll add details to our tech note and come prepared with a decision matrix (physical air-gap vs. virtual isolation) and the incremental operational burden for each option.

Proposed time for the deep-dive: 2027-06-08 09:00 PT (Jordan/Rishi/Marissa + Alex/Security team). Please confirm.

Thanks — Rishi

--
